report_name: Oculus Pathology Discloses Patient Data Breach from Email Compromise

identities.name: Oculus Pathology
identities.description: A Texas-based physician-owned pathology services provider that suffered a data breach due to compromised employee email accounts, potentially exposing patient PII and PHI.

indicators.name: Suspicious Inbox Forwarding Rule Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Inbox Forwarding Rule Creation
id: 2b1a987c-5d6e-4f3a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a new inbox rule that forwards emails to an external address. This is a common tactic used by attackers after compromising an email account to maintain access to communications.
references:
  - https://thinkoculus.com/notification-of-data-security-incident/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-11
modified: 2026-08-11
tags:
  - attack.t1114.003
level: high
logsource:
  product: m365
  service: audit.exchange
detection:
  selection:
    Operation: 'New-InboxRule'
    Parameters.Name:
      - 'ForwardTo'
      - 'ForwardingSmtpAddress'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of new email inbox rules that forward emails, a common technique used by attackers after a Business Email Compromise (BEC) to exfiltrate data or monitor communications.

indicators.name: Anomalous Sign-in from Non-Corporate Location
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Sign-in from Non-Corporate Location
id: 8d7c6b5a-4f3a-4e2d-9c8b-7a6f5e4d3c2b
status: experimental
description: Detects successful user sign-ins from locations outside of the organization's primary country of operation. This can indicate a compromised account being used by an external attacker.
references:
  - https://thinkoculus.com/notification-of-data-security-incident/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-11
modified: 2026-08-11
tags:
  - attack.t1078
level: medium
logsource:
  product: azure
  service: signinlogs
detection:
  selection:
    ResultType: 0
    Status.errorCode: 0
  filter_country:
    LocationDetails.countryOrRegion: 'US'
  condition: selection and not filter_country
indicators.description: Detects successful email account logins from unusual geographic locations or countries, which could indicate an attacker using compromised credentials.
